question: A sum of ₹16,875 was lent out at simple interest, and at the end of 1 year 8 months, the total amount was ₹18,000. Find the rate of interest per annum.
solution:
**Given:**

The sum of lent out at simple interest = 16,875

The amount = 18000

The time = 1 year 8 months

**Formula used:**

S.I={P× R× Tover100} Where, S.I. = Simple interest, P = Principle, R = Rate, and T = Time

**Calculation:**

Let the rate of interest R

The simple interest = 18000 - 16875 = 1125

Time = ({1+{8over12}})=({1+{2over3}})=({3+2over3})={5over3}

⇒ {1125}={{16875 × R× {5over3}}over100}

⇒ 1125 × 100 = 16875 × R × {5over3}

⇒ 112500 = 28125R

⇒ R = { 112500over28125} = 4%

**∴ The required result will be 4%.**
